note: a16z's third annual CIO survey (30 Jan 2026): 100 VP-and-above buyers at Global 2000 firms, surveyed by a third-party expert network. A second survey house beside Menlo; the construct is three or more model families (testing or production), stricter than Menlo's more than one model.
